# QRCode

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders text or binary data as a vector QR Code symbol.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IRoleProvider`, `IAltTextProvider`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new QRCode(options?: QRCodeOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`altText`](#alttext): Alternate text description for accessibility (e.g. "QR code to https://example.com").
- [`backgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): Quiet-zone colour.
- [`data`](#data): The data/text to encode in the QR Code.
- [`drawBackground`](#drawbackground): Whether to draw the background color.
- [`errorCorrection`](#errorcorrection): Error-correction level.
- [`foregroundColor`](#foregroundcolor): Module colour.
- [`isDecorative`](#isdecorative): When `true`, the QR code is purely decorative and is tagged as `/Artifact` with no alt-text warning.
- [`quietZone`](#quietzone): Number of quiet-zone modules around the QR code.
- [`semanticRole`](#semanticrole): The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. `SemanticRole.H1`, `SemanticRole.P`, `SemanticRole.Figure`).
- [`size`](#size): The display size of the QR code (QR codes are always square).

### `altText`

```typescript
altText: string
```

Alternate text description for accessibility (e.g. "QR code to https://example.com"). Populates the `/Alt` entry on the structure element when the document opts into PDF/UA-1.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/qr-codes`:

```typescript
basicQr.altText = 'QR code linking to bonniepdf.com';
```

Example, from `code-recipes/getting-started/simple-document`:

```typescript
qr.altText = 'QR code linking to https://bonniepdf.dev';
```

### `backgroundColor`

```typescript
backgroundColor: Color
```

Quiet-zone colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

Example, from `industry-templates/invoices/india-gst-invoice`:

```typescript
qr.backgroundColor = Color.white;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/qr-codes`:

```typescript
bgQr.backgroundColor = ColorPalette.rose[50];
```

### `data`

```typescript
data: string
```

The data/text to encode in the QR Code.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/qr-codes`:

```typescript
qr.data = urlData;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/invoices/india-gst-invoice`:

```typescript
qr.data = qrPayload;
```

### `drawBackground`

```typescript
drawBackground: boolean
```

Whether to draw the background color. If false, the QR code will be transparent.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/qr-codes`:

```typescript
transQr.drawBackground = false;
```

### `errorCorrection`

```typescript
errorCorrection: QrEcc
```

Error-correction level. Accepts `'low' | 'medium' | 'quartile' | 'high'`.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/qr-codes`:

```typescript
qr.errorCorrection = ecc;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/invoices/india-gst-invoice`:

```typescript
qr.errorCorrection = QrEcc.Medium;
```

### `foregroundColor`

```typescript
foregroundColor: Color
```

Module colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

Example, from `industry-templates/education-public-sector/course-certificate`:

```typescript
qr.foregroundColor = INK;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/qr-codes`:

```typescript
fgQr.foregroundColor = ColorPalette.blue[700];
```

### `isDecorative`

```typescript
isDecorative: boolean
```

When `true`, the QR code is purely decorative and is tagged as `/Artifact` with no alt-text warning.

### `quietZone`

```typescript
quietZone: number
```

Number of quiet-zone modules around the QR code. The spec recommends 4. Set to 0 to disable.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/qr-codes`:

```typescript
qr.quietZone = 1;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/invoices/india-gst-invoice`:

```typescript
qr.quietZone = 2;
```

### `semanticRole`

```typescript
readonly semanticRole: SemanticRole
```

*read-only*

The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. [`SemanticRole.H1`](semantic-role.md#h1), [`SemanticRole.P`](semantic-role.md#p), [`SemanticRole.Figure`](semantic-role.md#figure)).

### `size`

```typescript
size: number
```

The display size of the QR code (QR codes are always square).

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'3cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

Example, from `code-recipes/getting-started/simple-document`:

```typescript
qr.size = 90;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/education-public-sector/course-certificate`:

```typescript
qr.size = 42;
```
